messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: service=redwood-runtime env=prod tag=v2026.03.20-hf1 commit=3a7f9b2 change_window=immediate initiator=@elaine

elaine: kicking off hotfix for tokenization regression. rolling canary to 10% in us-west1 first.

kyle: ack, monitoring hooks in place. leaving canary at 10% for 15m before promoting.

marco: quick question — are we pinning model-replica to q4-2026-quant? need to avoid auto-rollback to older build.

elaine: yes pinning config. will set `model_version_pin: q4-2026-quant` for this rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary update: service=redwood-runtime env=prod region=us-west1 canary=10% status=success commit=3a7f9b2

oncall-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx rate in eu-west1 +2.8% since 2m. threshold=+2%

kyle: noted. eu-west1 wasn't in canary — sounds like unrelated infra noise. checking logs.

marco: Logs look like transient LB 502s; hitting load-balancer certificate rotation. ops on it.

deploy-bot: Promote scheduled: canary->50% in 5m unless rollback message.

elaine: hold — ops says cert rotation still rolling in eu-west1, hold promo to 50% until ops gives +1

ops-bot: cert rotation completed in eu-west1. no more LB 502s.

elaine: ok promoting now, re-enable canary promotion

deploy-bot: Promotion started: canary 10% -> 50% region=global

kyle: quick sanity check: increase CPU mem headroom for runtime workers to avoid OOMs during promo.

elaine: done, autoscaler bump applied: `min_replicas=4 -> 6` for redwood-runtime

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: service=redwood-runtime env=prod tag=v2026.03.20-hf1 commit=3a7f9b2 status=SUCCESS duration=00:17:46 rollout=50%

marco: Observability: latency stable, errors back to baseline. I think we can complete rollout to 100% in 30m.

elaine: agree. schedule final promotion at +30m unless alerts.

deploy-bot: Note: config pinned: `model_version_pin=q4-2026-quant` for this tag. To unpin run `rdwctl rollout-unpin --service redwood-runtime`

kyle: Thanks — filing release note: 'v2026.03.20-hf1: tokenization fix, model pin to q4-2026-quant, autoscaler bump'

elaine: adding that to release notes. cc @product for changelog

product: thanks — will include in weekly release summary.

elaine: closing thread once final rollout done. :white_check_mark:
